run_qr_dqn_atari: run QR-DQN on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable quantiles and steps
build_experiment_config: build a QR-DQN experiment config with distributional DQN network and Atari environment factory
run_distributed_experiment: run a distributed QR-DQN experiment with multiple actors using launchpad and xm resources
configure_dqn_hyperparameters: configure DQN hyperparameters like learning rate, n-step, replay size, and target update period
create_distributional_dqn_loss: create a QR-DQN loss function with configurable number of atoms and huber parameter
